title: Correct flow rate expression
description: Essential: The student's expression for Q_i must match the reference solution, Q_i = ΔP π r₀⁴ / (2^{i+3} N ℓ₀ η), or an algebraically equivalent form.

title: Correct numerical Q₀ value
description: Essential: The student must calculate Q₀ ≈ 1.44 ml/h (or 1.5 ml/h) after correct unit conversions from the given parameters.

title: Correct maximum thickness expression
description: Important: The student must derive the inequality h < (64 η² ℓ₀²) / (3 E ρ r₀³) from the condition in part A.3.

title: Correct tumour volume ratio
description: Essential: The student must derive the expression v = [1+μ - √((1+μ)² - 4μ(1-κ))] / [2(1-κ)] from mass and density relationships.

title: Correct central temperature expression
description: Important: The student must derive T(0) = T_body + (𝒫 R_T²)/(2k) from solving the heat balance equations with proper boundary conditions.

title: Correct minimum power per volume
description: Essential: The student must calculate 𝒫_min = 18k / R_T² and obtain the numerical value of 4320 W/m³ (or 4.32 kW/m³).

title: Correct relative flow drop expression
description: Important: The student must derive the final expression for δQ_{N-1}/Q_{N-1} as a function of v, K_N, and other parameters, using the linearized pressure-radius relation.

title: Unit conversion errors
description: Pitfall: Penalise incorrect conversion of pressure (mmHg to Pa) or volumetric flow rate (m³/s to ml/h).

title: Misapplication of series resistance
description: Pitfall: Penalise incorrectly summing resistances across the branching network or misusing the geometric scaling of vessel dimensions.

title: Algebraic manipulation errors
description: Pitfall: Penalise significant algebraic mistakes in deriving expressions, such as mishandling the quadratic equation for v or the heat balance constants.
